title: Enrollment, Activation and Program Review in Fulfilled by Northloop (FBN)
content:
**Terms.** A seller may enroll in Fulfilled by Northloop (FBN) only while holding a selling plan in one of the statuses listed as the required selling plan statuses; a seller without such a plan cannot enroll or be activated. A new enrollment starts in FBN Starter Program. Every review interval the enrollment is placed in the highest program whose minimum trailing 90-day units is met by the units shipped through FBN over the trailing 90 days; a program change takes effect on the review date and applies to every fee billed from that date, while fees for an earlier storage month or an earlier shipment keep the program in force when they were incurred.

## Life of an enrollment

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| pending | The seller has applied; the enrollment awaits approval. |
| active | The enrollment is approved and the seller may send inventory. |
| inbound suspended | New inbound shipments are blocked. |
| winding down | The seller has asked to leave FBN; remaining inventory must be removed or disposed. |
| closed | The enrollment has ended, or was declined or abandoned before approval. |

An application creates a pending enrollment in FBN Starter Program; approval moves it to active, and a declined or abandoned application moves it to closed.

## The trailing 90-day units

The units counted at a review are the units on the enrollment's outbound shipments for marketplace orders whose ship dates fall in the rolling 90 calendar days ending the day before the review date. For a review dated on a given day, the window runs from the 90th day before it through the day before it; shipments on the review date itself are not counted.

## Placement at a review (input, judgement, result)

- **Input:** the trailing 90-day units, and the minimum trailing 90-day units of each program.
- **Judgement:** every program whose minimum is met by those units qualifies; the highest of them is selected.
- **Result:** the enrollment is placed in that program from the review date. Placement may move the enrollment up or down.

## Which program prices a fee

| Fee | Program that applies |
|---|---|
| A fee billed on or after the review date | the program placed at the review |
| A storage month or shipment incurred before the review date | the program in force when it was incurred |

Illustration (hypothetical): a review on 1 July moves an enrollment from FBN Core Program to FBN Growth Program. A shipment of 28 June keeps FBN Core Program pricing; a fee billed on 1 July or later uses FBN Growth Program.
